name: cbr-with-reference-executor-unix
description: REFERENCE EXECUTOR. A composition of two implementations for the composition suite only: CBR's provider as every evidence, context and knowledge participant, and the protocol's own reference provider, built from the verified release extraction, as every participant configured with the launch configuration's `executor` member. The pinned runner starts every participant from one descriptor, so the launch argv is scripts/reference_executor_launch.py, which chooses the binary per participant. CBR never serves execution/1: the execution/1 profile, the execution.* features and the executor.script control below are the reference executor's, and a result from this descriptor is never real-adapter or PIO evidence. The other claims are CBR's, as in cbr-provider-unix.json. Run with --repo pointing at vendor/protocol/v0.1.0. Build first: cargo build --workspace, then scripts/build_runner.py --reference-executor.
